notes.title: New price on S-COPTER!
notes.content: Today we want to share a piece of good news with you! We are permanently lowering the price of our game S-COPTER: ToQFaL to [b]4.99$[/b]. With this, we are also denying rumours about our premature death – we are alive and kicking and still working on our next title!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - positive vibrations
notes.content:
Since last update we were working on our next game, but we took some time to make a small update to the first one :)
- added vibrations support to Xbox controllers (configurable in options, on by default),
- added animated background to the main menu.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - first after the release
notes.content:
The release went surprisingly well, there weren't many bugs and no game breaking ones :) This update fixes recently found bugs, changelog follows:
- added separator for the versus mode only keys,
- changed the mouse cursor, it's no longer locked in window mode,
- fixed winter and versus audio tracks mix up,
- fixed a rare spiteful passenger bug,
- fixed the slowdown effect on some traps (mainly spikes),
- fixed "Get to the chopper!" achievement earn moment,
- fixed some typos.

notes.title: Update 1.0.0 - just in time for the release :)
notes.content:
This is the last update before the official release tomorrow:
- added 1 new audio track,
- added 2 audio track remixes,
- changed music playlists of specific levels,
- disabled cheats :)

notes.title: Update 0.9.9
notes.content:
Hopefully the last fixes before release (there will still be an audio tracks update) :) Changelog follows:
- changed the achievement "I hate going back" to require 3 minutes or less (instead of 2:40),
- fixed stationary saw trap positioning,
- fixed some menu keyboard navigation issues,
- fixed some menu windows hiding under other windows,
- fixed game pad controls description.

- fixed a minor issue with the keybinding menu.

notes.title: Update 0.9.7
notes.content:
Today we've added more ways to enjoy a completed level. If you don't like to max out your completion time, you can take it slow and aim for the most steam-efficient way to complete a level :)
Changelog:
- added steam and durability stats to level details,
- added milliseconds to level time display,
- added 3 new audio tracks,
- fixed victory particles,
- fixed the "Soo close!" achievement,
- fixed the "Gotta catch them all!" achievement,
- fixed passengers queue on level 4.

notes.title: Update 0.9.5
notes.content:
So after hundreds of hours of testing, there was still a sneaky error causing traps to desynchronize with each other occasionally. We had to redo most of their code but it shouldn't happen anymore :)
Changelog is rather short this time around:
- fixed rare traps desynchronization,
- fixed some minor rounding errors.

notes.title: Steam Cloud
notes.content:
We have implemented the Steam Cloud feature.
All your profiles should now be synchronized between your Steam accounts on different computers.
Please let us know if you have any problems with that.
